patch.value:
## Problem

The docs gate checks that markdown links **resolve**. It does not check that
docs are **reachable**. Those are different properties, and only the first is
enforced, so a doc that nothing links to passes CI forever.

scripts/release/docs-skills-gate.mjs validates "relative markdown links in docs
+ README/AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING" — i.e. it catches a link pointing at a file that
does not exist (dangling link). It has no inverse check for a file that exists
and that no index points at (orphaned doc).

## Evidence 2026-07-26

AGENTS.md advertises docs/README.md as the "Full docs map" and the progressive
disclosure entrypoint. Measured against the actual docs/ tree:

| doc | in docs/README.md map | inbound links repo-wide |
|---|---|---|
| docs/PR_REVIEW_LOOP.md | no | **0** |
| docs/PERFORMANCE.md | no | 1 |
| docs/RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH.md | no | 2 |

docs/PR_REVIEW_LOOP.md is referenced by zero markdown files anywhere in the
repository. It is unreachable by any agent following the documented navigation
path, and unreachable by any human browsing the docs index.

## Why this is a gate gap, not a re-file of pm-c97q

pm-c97q (CLOSED, Chore) was "Docs index missing EXTENSION_AUTHOR_CONTRACTS +
MIGRATION_CLI_SIMPLIFICATION links". It fixed the two instances that existed at
the time by adding two links. It did not add an enforcement, so the class
recurred with three different files. Re-adding three links would reproduce the
same outcome a third time.

This item owns the enforcement: docs/README.md is a hand-maintained index over
a directory that changes, and hand-maintained indexes drift by default.

## Why it matters more here than in a typical repo

The project's stated navigation model is progressive disclosure: AGENTS.md is
deliberately short and routes to docs/ via the map. An unlinked doc is not
merely untidy — under that model it is invisible to the agent the doc was
written for, while still costing review and maintenance. It also directly feeds
the "the repo is getting confusing" symptom, because the on-disk tree and the
advertised map disagree with no signal that they do.

## Direction (not a mandate for the fix)

Extend docs-skills-gate.mjs with a reachability pass: every docs/*.md must be
linked from docs/README.md or from another doc reachable from it, with an
explicit opt-out list for deliberately standalone files so the gate stays
honest rather than being silenced wholesale. Then reconcile the three current
orphans — link them, or record them on the opt-out list, or delete
PR_REVIEW_LOOP.md if it is superseded.
The docs gate enforces link resolution but not doc reachability, so orphaned docs pass CI and the advertised docs map silently drifts

docs-skills-gate.mjs validates that relative markdown links resolve, but has no inverse check for docs nothing links to. docs/PR_REVIEW_LOOP.md has zero inbound links repo-wide; docs/PERFORMANCE.md and docs/RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH.md are absent from docs/README.md, the file AGENTS.md advertises as the full docs map.

The docs gate fails when a docs/*.md file is not reachable from docs/README.md, directly or transitively; An explicit opt-out list covers deliberately standalone docs so the gate is narrowed rather than silenced; docs/PR_REVIEW_LOOP.md, docs/PERFORMANCE.md and docs/RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH.md are each linked, opted out, or removed
Keeps the advertised progressive-disclosure map and the on-disk docs tree in agreement automatically, instead of after each manual audit.
Under a progressive-disclosure navigation model an unlinked doc is invisible to the agent it was written for while still costing review and maintenance.
A reachability pass in the docs gate with an explicit opt-out list, and the three current orphans linked, listed, or removed.
pm-c97q closed the same class by hand-adding two links and added no enforcement; the class has already recurred with three different files.

value.text: Fresh documentation topology evidence 2026-08-04: the tracked docs tree contains 75 files; docs/SDK.md alone is 3,182 lines and docs/COMMANDS.md 1,095 lines. The docs/skills freshness and link/content gate passes, but that does not establish reachability from the advertised docs map or prevent concept duplication across large reference documents. This item remains the canonical reachability owner.

value.text: Precedent for the reachability half of this chore: docs-skills-gate.mjs now has validateSkillReferenceReachability, which fails when a file under .agents/skills/<skill>/references is not linked from that skill's SKILL.md. It reuses the existing extractRelativeMarkdownLinks + resolveMarkdownLink pair, so the docs/ direction needs the same two calls against the docs map rather than new machinery. Negative control proven: an unlinked references/ORPHAN.md fails the gate naming the exact path; removing it restores the pass. Shipped under pm-f6zjpq.
